# cpanel_addon_domain (Data Source)

Looks up a cPanel addon domain and its internal subdomain and document root.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_addon_domain" "site" {
  domain = "site.example.net"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The addon domain name.

### Read-Only

- `document_root` (String) The document root relative to the cPanel account home.
- `domain_key` (String) The cPanel domain key used to identify the addon domain internally.
- `full_subdomain` (String) The complete internal subdomain created for the addon domain.
- `internal_subdomain` (String) The internal subdomain label created under the cPanel account main domain.
- `root_domain` (String) The cPanel account main domain that owns the internal subdomain.
